mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park tonight with a full moon. If you look toward the West Southwest over Mount Horeb at 9:40 PM, you can catch the ISS for one minute as it travels toward the Southwest. Tonight will cool down to a low of 70 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

In city news, students are encouraged to enter the I Voted sticker contest by submitting original designs to the City Clerk's office. Also, the Verona Senior Center is offering free rides on their trishaw bike program for residents, which requires filling out a waiver and release form either online or in person.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, don't miss the Farmer's Market on Wednesday at Hometown Junction Park.
On Saturday July 25, a 29-year-old Madison woman was arrested for her first O-W-I offense.
Enjoy the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day at Culver's today. They are open until 10 PM tonight. If you miss out, check back tomorrow when the flavor of the day will be Georgia Peach.
